name: Wise Widget Manager – Classic Widgets & Sidebar Control
author: bisnusnr

sections.description:
Wise Widget Manager is a powerful WordPress plugin that provides a centralized dashboard for managing all widget areas (sidebars) in classic WordPress themes.

Instead of navigating multiple disjointed layout screens in the WordPress admin, this plugin allows you to control, preview, and optimize all of your widgets from a single unified interface. It fundamentally enhances the traditional WordPress widget architecture without overriding or replacing it—making widget management faster, more visual, and completely seamless.

Important Note: This plugin is dedicated entirely to managing and configuring your active sidebars. To add new widgets to your site, you will still use the native WordPress flow by navigating to Appearance → Widgets. Once added, they will immediately appear in your Wise Widget Manager dashboard for quick management.

Features

  • Centralized Widget Dashboard: Manage all of your active widgets and sidebars from a single unified control center.
  • Drag-and-Drop Reordering: Effortlessly rearrange layouts and prioritize widget placement on the fly.
  • Isolated Live Previews: Safely preview widget modifications using strict iframe isolation before finalizing.
  • Instant Removal: Instantly purge unneeded widgets from any sidebar area.
  • Device-Based Visibility: Restrict widget visibility dynamically based on user device types – Desktop, iPad/Tablet, and Mobile.
  • Authentication Rules: Toggle widget presence based on user login status – show only to Logged In users or only to Non-Logged In visitors.
  • Classic & Gutenberg Support: Seamlessly manage both classic WordPress widgets and Gutenberg blocks side by side.
  • Search Widget Management: Quickly locate and manage all search widget instances across your sidebars.
  • Performance Optimized: Lightweight architecture using optimized WordPress REST API calls.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Tools → Wise Widget Manager
  4. Start managing your widgets
sections.faq:
Does this replace the default WordPress widgets screen?

No. It enhances the default system by providing a centralized management dashboard.

Is it compatible with block widgets?

It is primarily designed for classic themes and classic widgets, but it safely bridges traditional sidebars into a modern visual dashboard.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight, assets are compiled for production, and it communicates via optimized REST API endpoints.
